source.author: しゑひ(shiwehi)
source.fetch_method: curl through the session proxy, TLS verification ON, with --cacert naming a bundle that adds the Let's Encrypt YE2 intermediate (shiwehi.com omits it from its chain), the method STSD, STMB Cave, インペリアルクロス, ダブルダガー, BT砲, 千鳥格子, 社畜トレイン, 欄干, 山岳積み2号 and stick spin used. The snapshot is the page's raw HTML, byte for byte; every board is plain text in it, 11 ten-wide boards in page order.
source.snapshot_note: sha256 of the raw HTML this transcription was checked against. Not re-verifiable in CI: the page is not committed and cannot be fetched there. Re-check with --html-dir after any refetch (with harddrop's Kaidan_Setups.wikitext, Anchor_Set.wikitext and STMB_Cave.wikitext beside it); an HTML hash moves with ANY byte of the page (ads, sidebar, a date), so a moved hash means "read the board diff", not "the boards changed". Sentences are compared against the page with its tags dropped.

quotes.verbatim: ここでは、階段のドネイト(Kaidan Setups)という、ドネイトについて紹介していきます。
階段のドネイトとは、上手のように4段以上の階段ができている時に、%Zを縦向きに置くことによって%Tの形を作り、屋根をつけてT-spinを狙っていくというドネイトの一種です。
quotes.reading_note: 「上手のように」 is the page's own typo for 「上図のように」 (as the figures above it); quoted as printed

quotes.verbatim: 図を見ると分かるように、T-spinを打ちつつ地形を平らにすることができます。
また、下図のように階段が3段しかない場合にも%Sや%Jを使用することによって階段のドネイトを打つことができます。
階段のドネイトを打った後はST積みやよしひろ積みへ移行できます。
開幕DT砲後の階段のドネイト
開幕DT砲の派生として階段のドネイトを打つことができます。
%Lをソフトドロップした後に打つことができます。
%Jでアンカーセットを行って打つことができます。
アンカーセットを用いた階段のドネイト

nodes.label: a staircase of four steps down to the right wall, the wall column open two rows deep
a Z stood on end on the lowest step, at the wall: the T's slot
an O roofing the slot's end away from the wall
the T laid flat, pointing down: a TSD clearing the two rows the Z's top half is in
what the TSD leaves: the stack flat, and the wall column open from the top to the floor (the O drawn grey)
three steps: the Z and an S roofing the slot's end away from the wall
three steps: the Z and a J roofing the slot's end away from the wall, over a hole under its stem
after a Kaidan, the next stack begun (the page does not say which of ST積み and よしひろ積み)
after a Kaidan, the next stack begun with a stood T at the wall, which completes one row (the page names neither board)
after the DT砲 opener, the あめみや砲 branch (the L soft-dropped first): the Kaidan's TSD, mirrored
after the DT砲 opener, an アンカーセット with the J, then the Kaidan's TSD, mirrored

nodes.reading: s3.s less its S and Z: three steps
s3.j less its J and Z: three steps, a hole under the J's stem
dt.amemiya with its U read empty: the slot the T goes into
dt.anchor with its U read empty: the slot the T goes into

variants.window_note: in basic.spin's frame, row 0 the top: the AGREEMENT BOX of this page's three builds and two DT砲 boards (mirrored), harddrop's four Kaidan_Setups drawings, harddrop Anchor_Set's Kaidan (mirrored) and the Kaidan BT砲's harddrop record holds (mirrored). Row 1 is the row above the T: the roof over its end away from the wall filled, the cells over its nub, its far arm and the Z's top empty; rows 2-3 are the rows the TSD clears (entailed by the clear at a full TSD, NaiveClauseForced); rows 4-5 are the two rows under them: the Z's foot and the steps filled, the wall column (the well) empty. THE ONE CHOICE: there are three maximal boxes on which every drawing agrees (the cleared rows alone; the cleared rows and the well rows; this one), and this is the only one holding the roof. Occupancy only, never colour; garbage is filled.

untested_drawn.reason: the O roof's top row: the S and J forms roof the slot with a piece one row lower and draw nothing there, so the drawings disagree one row above the window

payoff.note: a Tetris into the column the TSD re-opens: HARDDROP's next step, not shiwehi.com's. harddrop's Kaidan_Setups page: 「After performing the T-Spin Double, the empty column should be open again. The Kaidan setup is especially effective in games that reward a Back-to-Back bonus.」; its Anchor_Set page draws the I clearing four into that column (cross_source.harddrop_anchor_set.payoff_drawing). shiwehi.com names no Tetris: its next step is ST積み or よしひろ積み, which nothing here measures. The matcher carries the well cell to the first later lock that puts a cell in its column and asks whether that lock is an I the engine credits with four lines

cross_source.note: the window, by the gate's predicate (technique_transcription.window_fires), over every U-slot board of every committed *-routes.json, with the U cells as the T: it fires on none, and no node is labelled 階段 or Kaidan. The independent drawer is harddrop instead: its Kaidan_Setups and Anchor_Set pages and the Kaidan its BT_Cannon page draws, whose drawings are the window's external `agreement` drawings (rule (g) fires the window on each, once, at its drawn T, in its recorded hand).
cross_source.routes_fire_none: no committed routes file draws a Kaidan (measured: the window fires on none of their U-slot boards at any resting placement, and no node is labelled 階段 or Kaidan); the cross-check is harddrop's own pages, read below
